item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: A journey through states of water
item.stem: Meena takes a steel glass of cold water out of the kitchen on a humid afternoon. After a few minutes, she notices droplets of water on the outside of the glass. Which statement correctly explains where these droplets come from?

options.A: Water from inside the glass seeps through the steel and collects outside.
options.B: Water vapour in the air touches the cold surface of the glass and condenses into liquid droplets.
options.C: The cold glass changes the air around it into water by evaporation.
options.D: Droplets form only because Meena's wet hands touched the glass earlier.
